thread:
maya: Good morning — quick preflight snapshot before cut window in 30.
maya: What I did: validated canary for model-serving-v2, trimmed two slow kernels in the runtime, updated rollback checklist.
maya: Blockers: CI flaky on integration-tests/ml-serve (timeout) and one cherry-pick (PR #892) awaiting review.
maya: Today: coordinate cut window, confirm backports, resolve CI flake or decide to skip, merge PR #892 if green.

tom: I saw the failure, I'm on it. suspect is a timeout when running on heavy-mem nodes. repro command locally: `pytest tests/integration/test_model_load.py::test_kv_cache -q -k ci`

leah: Cherry-pick #892 is from my perf/kv-cache branch. Left a note with test artifacts in the PR. Can someone give LGTM after CI passes? @tom can you run a quick smoke on Dedicated?

sam: I can run the smoke against dedicated-pool-a at 11:10 and validate p95/p99 during the short traffic spike.

deploy-bot: canary-deploy: model-serving-v2 -> us-west-2/canary (3 nodes) :white_check_mark:

maya: thanks @deploy-bot. @tom if you can't root cause the flake in ~20m we'll opt to skip that integration test in this cut and open a follow-up ticket. Need decision before cut.

tom: quick update — reproducing locally only when ASAN+TSAN flags are enabled; not seeing it on the normal CI runner. I'll re-run CI with stratified runners (heavy-mem + normal). ETA ~25m.

leah: ok I'll hold the cherry then. If it still flakes we can revert the perf tweak for this release and land later.

sam: FYI rollout traffic shaping is set to 10% -> 50% over 20m. graphs look clean so far. ping me once canary has steady metrics and I'll progress to 50%.

maya: Backports: sdk#411 and infra#670 need to be backported to 1.8.x. @leah can you prepare the patches? @sam can you validate the infra backport in staging?

leah: will open two backport PRs in ~15m and link them here.

tom: CI rerun started: https://ci.redwood-infra/ci/4823 — posting results when done.

maya: If CI is green and no other blockers we'll cut at +30. If not, we'll delay by 1h and publish the rollback plan. I've added a short rollback checklist in the release doc (see the release runbook link in the docs repo).

sam: noted. I'll watch metrics and will bump traffic on your ping.

leah: quick question — any secrets rotation that would affect private deployment tests? I saw a note in #eng-security earlier this morning.

maya: no rotations scheduled that affect today's tests; I checked with security last night.

deploy-bot: canary-monitor: healthchecks passing. latency p95=108ms, error rate=0.02% :eyes:

tom: CI passed on rerun — green across the stratified runners. https://ci.redwood-infra/ci/4823/result (all checks).

maya: great. @leah when your PRs are up tag me, I'll queue the merge and then cut. Thanks all — keep this thread for any last-minute cut-window notes. :tada:
